video.title: How To Ship Real Code With AI (Not Junk)

abstract: David Cramer, co-founder of Sentry, gives a grounded view of AI-assisted software development: AI is useful, but production-quality software still requires judgment, verification, accountability, and maintenance.
mainTakeaway: AI can meaningfully improve developer workflows, especially for search, summarization, knowledge retrieval, and prototypes. But Cramer rejects “100x developer” hype: LLMs often generate bloated or risky code, and verification remains the hard part . Video Float − + Dock
